thread:
samir: Heads-up — noticed tenant org view lost the latency tail lines after the prometheus-adapter canary rolled to prod (~12:03 UTC). p95/p99 are gone, p50/p90 still visible. Screenshot: https://redwood.app/s/shot.png :eyes:

maya: same for staging earlier, saw p95 disappear around the canary window. p90 stayed. :thinking:

leah: can you paste the raw panel query? might be a label name change from the adapter swap.

samir: panel query (copied from dashboard):
```
sum by (org,route,quantile) (rate(latency_summary_quantile{job="ingest"}[5m]))
```
Note: our summary exporter used to expose a `quantile` label (0.95, 0.99). The new adapter seems to convert to histogram buckets and strips that label.

raj: yep — prometheus-adapter converts summary -> histogram differently; summaries' quantile labels don't show up after the adapter. We rely on that `quantile` label to render p95/p99 lines. Quick curl of /metrics confirms no `quantile=` entries for latency.

samir: repro steps I ran: 
```
# on prod metrics endpoint
curl -s "https://ingest.prod.internal/metrics" | grep latency | head
# result: latency_* entries but no 'quantile' labels anymore
```

leah: short-term fix options: 1) revert the adapter canary; 2) change dashboards to compute percentiles from histogram buckets using histogram_quantile(); 3) add relabeling in scrape/adapter to synthesize quantile labels (gross). Which do we want?

maya: ops preference was to roll the adapter because it fixes other issues, so reverting might be disruptive. I can try a dashboard patch to use histogram_quantile for org-level panels as a canary-friendly change.

deploy-bot: prometheus-adapter canary rolled to prod at 2026-03-17T12:03:18Z (deploy id: pa-2026-03-17-1203).

raj: note: histogram_quantile requires le labels and bucket style metrics. Our ingest exporter has buckets but they are at route+org granularity only after aggregation; org rollups might be slightly noisier. Worth testing.

samir: filed SUPPORT-3219 with logs + screenshot + this repro. Linking in ticket.

leah: action items:
- leah -> update the org view panels to histogram_quantile(0.95/0.99, sum(rate(latency_bucket[5m])) by (le,org,route)) as a short-term fix.
- ops -> evaluate adding relabel in adapter or revert if dashboard fixes break other things.
- doc -> update runbook to prefer histogram-based queries for adapter-backed metrics.

maya: pushing a small dashboard patch to canary now, will validate on acme tenant view in ~10m.

samir: thanks. tagging @ops @dash-team in the ticket.

leah: update — dashboard patch restored the p95/p99 lines on org view for the tenants I tested (acme/stage). We'll keep the adapter canary running while ops investigates long-term relabeling or exporter changes. Plan: formalize query migration in the grafana docs this week. :white_check_mark:
